dct_description_sm: According to the preface, Seller had planned the work in 4 books. The Brit. Mus. Cat. v. 218, 698 lists a copy with the third book of which 24 pages were published.

According to the preface, Seller had planned the work in 4 books. The Brit. Mus. Cat. v. 218, 698 lists a copy with the third book of which 24 pages were published. Each volume also has special title page. Vol. 1 has 25 maps of which the 3d is in duplicate; the 12th (as recorded in P. L. Phillips, A list of geographical atlases. 1914, p. 617-618) is wanting; v. 2 has 21 maps. English Short Title Catalogue (ESTC) R37362 Library of Congress. Lessing J. Rosenwald collection, 1516 LAC knj 2019-07-02 update (2 cards) LAC ddw 2022-03-01 update (1 card)
Contributors: Darby, John, 1624 or 1625-1704, printer; Lessing J. Rosenwald Collection (Library of Congress); Seller, John, active 1658-1698
Each volume also has special title page.

Publication statement: [London, Printed by J. Darby] sold by the author [1671-72]

dct_title_s: The English pilot, describing the sea-coasts, capes ... in the northern and southern navigation, shewing the courses and distances ... and many other necessary things belonging to the practical part of navigation, being furnished with new and exact draughts, charts, and descriptions
